article_ai_revolution.summary: Artificial intelligence moved from research papers to daily tools in a few years, and it now touches your work, your phone and your money. After reading this you can explain what modern AI actually does, name the jobs it does well and badly, spot the three failure modes before you trust an answer, and decide what to hand over to a machine and what to keep.
article_ai_revolution.title: The AI Revolution: How Smart Machines Are Changing Our Lives
